responsibility: Declares the public dominance and postdominance API for CFG clients. It defines the dominance direction and availability-state enums and publishes interfaces for computing and freeing dominance info globally or for regions, querying and setting immediate dominators, enumerating dominated blocks, redirecting dominance children, finding nearest common dominators, testing domination, verifying invariants, incrementally fixing dominators, and accessing dominance-tree child traversal and availability state.
same_name_distinction: Defines the public dominance/postdominance enums and APIs for CFG clients, in contrast to dominance.cc which contains the actual dominator algorithms and maintenance logic.
